assertions.reason: The Linux desktop-entry template and bundle script consistently render Neo Zed identities: neozed is the CLI/icon name, x-scheme-handler/neozed is registered, APP_ID values are dev.neozed*, and archive/app directory names are neozed-based.

evidence.summary: The desktop template uses TryExec=$APP_CLI, Exec=$APP_CLI $APP_ARGS, Icon=$APP_ICON, Keywords=neozed, and MimeType x-scheme-handler/neozed.
The Linux bundle script exports APP_CLI="neozed", APP_ICON="neozed", per-channel Neo Zed APP_NAME/APP_ID values, creates neozed$suffix.app, and archives neozed-linux-${arch}.tar.gz.
The Snap app stanza exposes command: usr/bin/neozed and common-id: dev.neozed alongside the Neo Zed package name.
Saved the Linux desktop integration evidence and scoped absence checks to evidence/desktop-packaging/linux-release-packaging/metadata-audit.json.

assertions.reason: Linux package metadata and install flows now use Neo Zed names, commands, URLs, and repo links across Snap, Flatpak, and the install/uninstall scripts.

evidence.summary: Snap metadata uses name neozed, title Neo Zed, website https://neozed.dev/, source-code https://github.com/Nkr1shna/neo-zed/, and the neozed release tarball URL.
Flatpak metadata uses developer id dev.neozed, Neo Zed branding, neozed.dev URLs, and fork repository links.
The installer downloads asset=neozed from cloud.neozed.dev, emits Neo Zed messaging, and installs neozed binaries and dev.neozed app IDs.
The uninstall flow removes Neo Zed app bundles, neozed CLI symlinks, and dev.neozed-derived Linux/macOS data directories.
Saved the Linux package-metadata audit to evidence/desktop-packaging/linux-release-packaging/metadata-audit.json.

assertions.reason: The audited bundling and release workflows publish Neo Zed desktop app artifact names for the Linux tarball, macOS DMGs, and Windows EXEs, with no old zed-prefixed desktop app artifact names remaining in those release-facing files.

evidence.summary: The run_bundling workflow uploads neozed-linux-*.tar.gz, neozed-*.dmg, and neozed-*.exe artifacts.
The release workflow uploads, renames, and verifies the expected Neo Zed desktop app artifact set before gh release upload.
The nightly release workflow mirrors the Neo Zed artifact naming for tarball, DMG, and EXE outputs.
Saved the workflow artifact-name matrix and scoped absence checks to evidence/desktop-packaging/linux-release-packaging/metadata-audit.json.

assertions.reason: Registry/package metadata in the audited package manifests and release workflows points at Neo Zed fork surfaces, including neozed.dev URLs and the Nkr1shna/neo-zed repository.

evidence.summary: Snap metadata points at neozed.dev and https://github.com/Nkr1shna/neo-zed/ for website, source-code, issues, and release asset URLs.
Flatpak metadata uses neozed.dev for homepage/help/contact/faq and the fork repository for bugtracker, vcs-browser, and contribute URLs.
Release publication uses gh release upload/view/edit commands against the Nkr1shna/neo-zed repository.
After-release refresh and announcement URLs point at cloud.neozed.dev and neozed.dev release pages.
Saved the registry/package URL audit and scoped absence checks to evidence/desktop-packaging/linux-release-packaging/metadata-audit.json.
